|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Rogue Squadron X-wing]]; it is the current text. No published image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB6-34-Rogue_Squadron_X_wing-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026). The Virtual Block 6.3 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image show the original text; see [[Rogue Squadron X-wing]].
* '''Original''' ([[Rogue Squadron X-wing]]): text as given in the Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet (official text as of 15 March 2010): “May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. While Rebel Aces on table, pilot is forfeit +2 and this starship may not be lost before the damage segment of battle. Matching starship for any Rogue Squadron pilot.”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock6_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 6.3 release sheet] ("official text as of 15 March 2010"; released 12 March 2010), page 6, slip 334. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022213441/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_3.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee released the Virtual Block 6.3 (Mercenaries) sheet on 12 March 2010, three days before the date it carries.<ref name="pc-6_3-release">Players Committee home page, news “Virtual Block 6.3: Mercenaries – Released!”, posted 4:40pm Friday, 12 March 2010, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20100409002355/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ 9 April 2010] (Internet Archive); the Players Committee Twitter account wrote on 13 March 2010 that the set “has been released early!” ([https://web.archive.org/web/20100721144451/http://twitter.com/swccg Internet Archive copy])</ref> The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints the same text.<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=51, page 51. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=51 Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): errata posted on the Players Committee forum on 9 July 2014, effective immediately: “and this starship may not be lost before the damage segment of battle” became “and, if in battle, this card may not be lost before the damage segment”: “May add 1 pilot and 1 astromech. While Rebel Aces on table, pilot is forfeit +2 and, if in battle, this card may not be lost before the damage segment. Matching starship for any Rogue Squadron pilot.”<ref name="forum-p890420">Players Committee forum, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 9 July 2014: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p890420 p890420] (read 9 November 2026)</ref> The post (“a few extremely minor errata … effectively immediately”) quotes only the changed sentence as [OLD GAME TEXT] and [NEW GAME TEXT]; the rest of the text is unchanged. The rules team called it “not a gameplay change”.
